notes: Model eleven_v3 (most expressive; supports POST /v1/text-to-speech/{voice_id}/with-timestamps - tested OK, returns per-character alignment, so no forced-alignment needed; /v1/forced-alignment remains the fallback). Write for the ear: short sentences, contractions, fragments and ellipses ('...') for beats. Audio tags allowed, use sparingly: [pause], [softly], [excited], [thoughtful], [short pause]. Spell out numbers as spoken. Do not exceed ~3000 chars per call. Loudness-normalise (loudnorm -16 LUFS, TP -1.5) in post; raw samples sit at about -15 to -19 LUFS. Output mp3_44100_128. v3 ignores 'speed' in practice; control pace with punctuation/tags. Settings: stability 0.5 (natural), similarity_boost 0.8.
